textRuns.value: Right-click a project and choose Drill through to open it. Pick a pillar to re-rank by that part only. Blank means not measured. Active projects only: inactive ones are listed below, or clear Project Status in the Filters pane. Rating cut-offs are proposed.

Literal.Value: 'Right-click a project and choose Drill through to open it. Pick a pillar to re-rank by that part only. Blank means not measured. Active projects only: inactive ones are listed below, or clear Project Status in the Filters pane. Rating cut-offs are proposed.'
